listings.description: In perfect rhythm, freshness finds its place. Bergamot sparks the moment, orange blossom keeps it flowing, cedarwood brings the subtle intensity. Cedrus Blanc swings the trail of freshness around you. Cedrus Blanc is an impeccable balance of freshness and intensity. .

. A presence that makes every room feel magical, a deep sweetness rises first, rich like sun-soaked fruit. It softens into the glow of orange blossom, before violet lingers. . Nava Sol - A fragrance that exist between culture and class. .

For days that feel brighter and fresh than usual. Rayhaan Aloha a fragrance that feels like summer without an end. A splash of citrus, a wave of watermelon, and a fresh Hawaiian escape in every spray. Individually beautiful, Together, Unforgettable .

Capture the experience of euphoria and dreams of exciting adventures with Rayhaan Divine. This is the scent of a moment that feels truly special, made to last! . It has the surprising elegance of litchi & rose, grounded by the earthy embrace of patchouli. It’s both light and deeply sensual with a romantic Rose. .
Freshness you see, energy you feel. Meet your summer reflection - Rayhaan Azul Made for sunlit days and after-hours freshness. Rayhaan Azul freshness awaits .

Pharaoh stands as more than a fragrance. It is a presence, a legacy in bottle, a symbol of command! . Sourced for its depth, cured for its darkness, it brings warmth that linger and anchors everybody that bruises by you! .

A fragrance that’s as complex as the earth itself. For those who seek the extraordinary. Warmth and spice meet in Terra, a fragrance that envelops you with the heat of cardamom and frankincense, resting on a base of amber and oud. Bold, mysterious, unforgettable. . Unveil the mystery with Rayhaan Terra, its sophisticated and earthy, a fragrance for those who seek complexity and depth. .

. Command attention with Rayhaan Wolf. This captivating fragrance blends the spicy warmth of cardamom with an addictive, gourmand hit of rich toffee. . Anchored by a smooth, long-lasting amber wood base, it delivers a complex and magnetic scent designed for those who naturally stand out. Wear it when you want to leave a lasting impression. .

Some fragrances enter a room, others change the air entirely. . Nocturno Elixir moves through the night like a quiet force, unseen, undeniable, unforgettable. Golden amber twists through shadow, circling a scent made for midnight rituals. .

Unearthed like a monument. Revered like a ritual. An essence that unfolds slowly, confidently, deliberately. Warm. Deep. Commanding. . A fragrance that carries history on skin, and presence in every moment. Some perfumes tell a story, Tonquin Giza is a story .

Tropical Vibe by Rayhaan. A taste of summer, that feels like a beach sunset. Exotic fruits, marine whispers, amber warmth. . Bursting with mango, pineapple, and a hint of coconut—pure tropical bliss. Spray, drift, escape. . One spritz & it’s golden sands, ocean waves & the sweet glow of a tropical island. .

Rayhaan Valhalla - An Intoxicatingly warm, irresistibly sweet & a taste of heaven! The might of Rayhaan & the creativity of Legion come together to make an enchanting fragrance, its rich, fruity, woody & boozy. Experience a captivating opening of Raspberry & Cognac that deepens into a heart of Tonka Bean, Bulgarian Rose, and Oakmoss. A rich, warm base of Praline, Oak, and Sandalwood lingers, leaving an unforgettable impression. .

Introducing Rayhaan Jungle Vibe - Your escape into the wild. A fragrance that’s fresh, vibrant, and full of nature’s vitality. burst of citrus and greenery, with Bergamot and Grapefruit at the forefront, followed by the smooth embrace of Fig and Sandalwood.. Perfect for those who crave adventure, bringing the outdoors to life with a fragrance that’s as lively as a jungle breeze!.

Rayhaan Kiss - A luscious opening of candy, sparkles with the blissful blend of sweet and sour, Every spray feels like the rush of a stolen kiss, unexpected, thrilling, unforgettable. . This is Sweetness Matured. Sensuality Refined. .

Rayhaan Obsidian - Sophistication, strength, and mystery combined. A fragrance designed for those who live with power and elegance in every step. From the delicate freshness of Iris to the warm embrace of Oud, Leather & Cedar, Obsidian is sure to leave a lasting impression..

Rayhaan Aquatica is a scent that captures the spirit of endless summers and ocean breezes- where every spray tells a story of adventure, freshness, and elegance.. Discover the fragrance that takes you places and Dive into freshness with Aquatica!.

Rayhaan Italia is an essence of timeless elegance, capturing the spirit of a sun-kissed morning. Fresh, warm, and effortlessly captivating. Its bright, sweet, and beautifully complex. . From the zest of Bergamot to the warmth of Tobacco Leaf, and the sweet warmth of honey, Italia is a journey through fragrance, leaving a lasting impression with every wear!.

Rayhaan Nocturno is a striking fusion of freshness and depth, crafted for the modern man who moves with quiet strength and magnetic presence. It opens with a burst of juicy bergamot and spicy pepper, igniting the senses with crisp intensity.. As it settles, a refined blend of lavender, dry woods, and subtle resinous notes creates a sophisticated heart—cool, composed, and effortlessly powerful. The base reveals warm ambroxan, smoky incense, and earthy vetiver, leaving behind a bold, lingering trail that’s both clean and commanding..

Rayhaan Pacific Aura captures the essence of a serene coastal breeze with a refreshing twist. This radiant summer fragrance opens with a burst of cool mint and zesty citrus, instantly uplifting the senses like sunlight on ocean waves. . At its heart, soothing herbal notes blend with juicy fig and crisp green accords, creating a clean, revitalizing character that feels effortlessly elegant. .

Introducing RAYHAAN TIGER CAL COLOGNE EDITION , a captivating fragrance that embodies raw strength and refined elegance. This seductive scent opens with a vibrant blend of spice and freshness, setting a bold first impression. At its heart lies a warm, exotic depth, balancing sensual florals with hints of rich and precious woods. The finish is an alluring fusion of Patchouli, Frankincense & Amber, leaving a magnetic trail that resonates with confidence and charisma. TIGER is crafted for the man who exudes power and sophistication—an unforgettable scent for the true modern seducer. .

Rayhaan Crimson – A Bold Expression of Power and Elegance. . A fragrance that commands attention, Rayhaan Crimson exudes warmth, depth, and undeniable allure. Its rich, spicy character unfolds into a refined blend of sensuality and strength, leaving behind an irresistible, long-lasting trail. Perfect for those who embrace confidence and sophistication, Crimson is more than a scent—it’s a statement..

Introducing RAYHAAN LION , an irresistibly bold fragrance crafted for the confident, modern man. This powerful scent opens with a refreshing burst that quickly warms into a smooth, spicy heart, exuding an air of refined allure. The finish is rich and sensual, wrapped in notes that leave a lasting impression of warmth and sophistication. LION is a tribute to strength, charm, and undeniable appeal—a fragrance as magnetic and timeless as the man who wears it. .

Presenting RAYHAAN ELIXIR….the latest AROMATIC AMBERY WOODY creation by Rayhaan Perfumes! This powerful scent ignites your feelings adding a sensual touch at its base. Starting with a zesty citrusy note fueled by minty freshness, the fragrance quickly unveils its richness of lavender and benzoin complimented with accents of sweet vanilla. Trumped with warm notes of tonka beans in between addictive notes of honey and tobacco, the culmination is as rich as the beginning. The gold is symbolic of divinity and power; a perfect look to the perfect scent! The Exemplary, The Everlasting, THE ELIXIR…...

Bluetiful is a wonderful choice for women who strive for harmony and tranquility. The combination of sage, mandarin orange, and narcissus notes creates a scent that reminds of the coolness of the azure sea and summer breeze. This perfume emphasizes the natural beauty of its owner, giving her tenderness and sensuality, as well as revealing her best qualities

Pretty in Pink - this premium women's perfume is an embodiment of romance and femininity. Notes of blackcurrant, May rose, and ambroxan create a fragrance that has both a delicate and strong character. It emphasizes the femininity and elegance of its owner, creating an aura of mystery and sexuality around her.

Back to Black is a luxurious women's perfume created for those who strive to stand out from the crowd. Notes of pear, bergamot, and orange blossom create a unique scent that will not leave any woman indifferent. Back to Black is capable of emphasizing the elegance, sensuality, and individuality of its owner, conveying confidence and strength to her.

DAHLIYA - a premium women's fragrance inspired by juicy and sweet pear and melon fruits, as well as the elegant magnolia flower. This fragrance will give you a feeling of lightness and brightness, and will also adorn any outfit with its exquisite composition. DAHLIYA is every woman's dream of simplicity and elegance.

FLORIANA is a premium women's fragrance that captivates with its refinement and lightness. It is inspired by the scent of orange and bergamot flowers, which give the fragrance freshness and delicacy, as well as Indian jasmine, which adds notes of passion and sensuality. FLORIANA will give you a spring mood and lightness, as well as a feeling of endless feminine beauty and energy.

AYKA is a premium women's perfume inspired by the delicate peony flowers, the freshness of citrus, and the warmth of sandalwood. It's a unique combination of notes that accentuate femininity and add uniqueness and charm. It's an incredibly captivating scent that can also give you confidence in your strength and energy.

Dark Leather perfume is a strong and deep scent inspired by night walks in dense forests and rugged masculinity. The combination of nutmeg sage, juniper, and orris helps create a magnetic fragrance that will make you stand out from the crowd and attract the attention of those around you. Dark Leather is a scent for a real man who is not afraid to take responsibility and dominate in his environment.

Corium is the best perfume for men who love to feel power and strength in their scent. With a sparkling blend of chestnut, sage, and leather notes, it will transport you to a world of the past where heroes fought for their ideals and emerged victorious. In it, you will find someone who is not afraid to take risks and go beyond the standards - a multi-faceted owner. Using Corium, a man gains confidence and appears irresistibly attractive to those around him.

Cordova perfume is an elegant and refined scent for a true gentleman. Experience the captivating fusion of leather with cypress and patchouli, which together create a unique atmospheric scent game - making it equally suitable for everyday wear and special occasions. Cordova conveys a rich history through a multitude of charming and mesmerizing notes.

Wood Noir is a fragrance for men who are looking for a unique scent that sets them apart from everyone else. Cardamom adds a spicy tone, while sandalwood gives the fragrance warmth and softness, and vanilla adds a caramel scent that originates from the cardamom note. All of these elements combined create a unique and intriguing scent that is suitable for men who appreciate elegance and charm, allowing them to stand out from the crowd.

Royal Wood is a fragrance for men who want to look and feel royal. The scent begins with lemon oil for freshness, while LMR cinnamon bark oil adds warmth and a special quintessential aroma. Amber wood creates the base, giving the fragrance depth and power. Royal Wood is a scent that emphasizes your status and gives you confidence.

Ellwood is a fragrance for men who want to experience the power and elegance of nature in its most sublime form. Notes of Italian bergamot add freshness, while cypress and Virginia cedarwood create a deep and explosive scent. Ellwood is an enticing, energetic, and masculine fragrance that will definitely attract attention.

Pacific - a fragrance of fresh bergamot and lemon that will fill you with energy and vitality. Cypress is a note that adds masculinity and strength, giving the image uniqueness and individuality. Pacific is a perfume for successful and self-confident men who are not afraid to challenge the world.

Fresh Wave - a perfume that will envelop you in the freshness of ocean breeze. The scent of mint and lavender creates a unique aroma that will accentuate your style and character. Notes of geranium complement the composition, adding elegance and sophistication to it. Fresh Wave is a premium perfume that will make your personality brighter and more memorable.

Imperia Legacy is a perfume for men who strive to leave a deep mark in the history of their lives. Its floral bouquet of artemisia, coriander spices, and patchouli is a true embodiment of the skill and talent of perfumers who created this work of art. Imperia Legacy is a fragrance that will transport you to the era of ancient warriors and powerful commanders who left behind a rich legacy and countless legends and stories.

Imperia is a premium men's fragrance that embodies the spirit of the ancient Roman Empire. It starts with notes of Italian bergamot, adding a fresh, apple heart and an elegant trail of mint to the composition. Imperia is a scent of victory and glory that is best suited for those who are ready to conquer the world with their supernatural abilities.

Ocean Rush is a perfume that will fill you with energy, making your image uncompromising and daring. The scent of green mandarin adds a touch of freshness, aquazone - the water element, and amber (mineral) complements the composition with a note of refinement and elegance. Ocean Rush is a perfume for determined and indomitable men, ready to do anything to achieve their goals.

Imperia Intence is a new, more intense fragrance created for bold and daring men. Like in the original scent, there are bright, daring notes of star anise, which are accompanied by spicy pepper and lavender. The intensity of the fragrance and complex notes make Imperia Intence the perfect choice for those who want to stand out from the crowd and be noticed for their unique style and character.
